## Use DM Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set DM Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'DM Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

DM Mono is available from Google Fonts.

[Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Mono)

## About the DM Mono coding font

A clean, low-contrast monospace from Colophon Foundry. DM Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

DM Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## DM Mono FAQ

### Is DM Mono free?

Yes. DM Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does DM Mono support ligatures?

No. DM Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get DM Mono?

DM Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
